newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk shares firm 0.8 pct, awaiting censure motion.
newsitem.headline: Turk shares firm 0.8 pct, awaiting censure motion.

text.p: Istanbul shares firmed in quiet and range-bound trade on Monday as the market awaited Tuesday's censure motion vote in parliament which threatens the Islamist-led coalition government, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 closed up 13 points, or 0.8 percent at 1,628. Trade volume dived to 20.62 trillion lira ($170.1 million) from Friday's 30.42 trillion ($251.5 million).

"The market tried to keep its gains via activity in shares of largely state owned firms, but in general, trade was dull. The market will move according to tomorrow's censure motion vote results," said Mustafa Karaahmetoglu from Sayilgan securities.
Parliament will convene at 1300 GMT on Tuesday to debate a censure motion filed by two leftist parties against the coalition.
The index had gained 3.86 percent last week amid relief after parliament rejected sending Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller to the Supreme Court in three corruption charge votes.
